Both TryAll and SurfaceArray build 32 sensitive modules in two barrel and two disc layers; each matches 200 seeded analytic ray comparisons. Direct transform, sensitivity and child-enumeration limitations documented. No human approval inferred. No physical field-map or reconstruction validation. On 2026-09-28 the response replaces JSON as the recommended construction API with Python loops and blueprint code. Patched source build matches JSON IDs/navigation/propagation exactly across 1600 ray comparisons and 192 propagations; samples are repeated controls, not independent statistics. Four new upstream test cases fail before the setter patch; 20 focused tests and all pre-commit hooks pass after it. Original wheel controls still pass. ACTS PR #6176 supplies the missing setter; historical reports are preserved. After the user installed matplotlib, the full ACTS Python Core suite passed: 56 passed, 1 skipped.
